reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. I treated the 23 May date as unconfirmed and didn't record it anywhere as fact.

I couldn't find anything to back it up. No Thornbury Cloth Co. files are in the share she can see, and nobody in #central-team has mentioned their order form. I also pointed out that 23 May has already passed this year, so they may mean May 2027 or the date was misheard. I suggested she get the deadline in writing from Thornbury, or check with whoever owns the account, before anyone plans around it.

I didn't use the wider message search or look at anything she couldn't see herself.
